headlines.title: Chipotle Is Down 14% Compared to McDonald's 24%. But There's an Even Better Restaurant Stock to Buy in October.
headlines.summary: Texas Roadhouse may be worth a closer look after its recent pullback, especially with sales growing, new restaurants opening, and a dividend returning cash to shareholders.

headlines.title: McDonald’s (MCD) Stock Looks Fairly Valued After Loyalty Program Launch
headlines.summary: McDonald's has seen its share price fall sharply this year. That puts fresh focus on a simple question for investors: how much of the current valuation is really supported by the cash the business can generate over time? The stock is down 23.6% year to date, so the market is already repricing expectations. That puts extra weight on whether the underlying cash flows still justify today's level.

headlines.title: McDonald's quietly changes how 14,000 stores price your Big Mac
headlines.summary: McDonald’s has quietly rolled out an AI pricing tool across 14,000 U.S. stores. In Fresno, customers are already driving the extra mile.

headlines.title: McDonald’s (MCD) Launches a Media Network and Starts Selling Drive-Thru Ads
headlines.summary: McDonald’s Corporation (NYSE:MCD) said on September 23 that it will build its own advertising business, selling space on the digital screens customers already stand and sit in front of. A pilot began last month across 450 company-owned restaurants, running third-party ads on digital drive-thru order boards.

headlines.title: Sozzi weighs in on Micron's blowout quarter, chats with Meta's former CTO, & more
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi takes a look at the biggest stories as the trading day kicks off, weighing in on Nike's (NKE) upcoming earnings report, Paramount's (PSKY) new co-CEO, and more.Former Meta (META) CTO Mike Schroepfer sits down with Sozzi for a conversation about Meta Muse and the AI build-out. Schroepfer is also the founding partner of Gigascale Capital.

description: McDonald's Corporation owns, operates, and franchises restaurants under the McDonald's brand in the United States and internationally. It offers food and beverages, including hamburgers and cheeseburgers, various chicken sandwiches, fries, shakes, frozen desserts, sundaes, soft serve cones, cookies, pies, soft drinks, coffee, and other beverages; and full or limited breakfast, as well as sells various other products during limited-time promotions. The company owns and operates franchised restaurants under various structures, including conventional franchise, developmental license, or affiliate. McDonald's Corporation was founded in 1940 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.
